articles.summary: Today, Skyward Specialty expands its E&S Property offering with the addition of excess coverage, strengthening support for layered programs addressing technically complex, non-catastrophe property risks. This expansion reflects our disciplined Rule Our Niche strategy and continued investment in scalable solutions where the traditional market falls short.
articles.title: Skyward Specialty Expands Its E&S Property Offering - Skyward Specialty Insurance

articles.summary: Skyward Group is the unified holding company brand following Skyward Specialty’s acquisition of Apollo. Skyward Specialty and Apollo will continue to operate as the Company’s market-facing brands, preserving their distinct identities while aligning under a shared vision and strategy.
articles.title: Skyward Specialty Introduces Skyward Group as New Holding Company Brand - Skyward Specialty Insurance
